usedFor: Dubble holds guides and collections, and Microsoft Excel receives a table row through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “Guide Added to a Collection” in Dubble, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each guide added to a collection is logged as a row, giving you a running list.

watchOut: “Add Row To Table” writes into an Excel table, so the table must exist before the template runs.
